title: Maintenance Technician
description:
Summary: 

RectorSeal is seeking an experienced Maintenance Technician at our injection molding/extrusion facility in Fall River. The Maintenance Technician will work with our team to maintain and repair molding machines, extruders, granulators, chillers, temp controllers, conveyors, and custom equipment and automation.

RectorSeal manufactures and/or distributes a variety of chemical and mechanical products for the HVAC, electrical, and plumbing industries. For over 80 years, RectorSeal?s customers have depended on us for quality products with excellent value, shipped to them in a timely manner. This passion for excellent customer service is the reason RectorSeal has been growing at a very fast pace, and now requires additional shift capacity to meet customer demand. The Maintenance Technician will provide technical support sitewide to ensure our products are delivered safely, productively, and on time in accordance with our customer-focused core values.

Key Responsibilities:
  • Ensure operation of machinery and electronic equipment by completing preventive maintenance requirements on motors, pumps, hydraulics, pneumatics, and conveyor systems.
  • Troubleshoot and repair breakdowns of molding machines, extruders, grinders, chillers, temp controllers, conveyors and other industrial equipment.
  • Work with outside vendors as needed for service support, parts supplies, etc. Support outside contractors scheduled to complete projects within the facility.
  • Understand technical documents and equipment specifications.
  • All performed work to meet industry safety standards and guidelines.
  • Use of computerized maintenance management system (Fixx) for completing tasks


Required Experience
  • Minimum 3 years of experience in job related field
  • Experience in fast paced industrial environment
  • Must possess or willing to acquire NFPA 70E Certification
  • Troubleshooting and problem solving
  • Work with automated equipment and PLCs a plus

title: Technician
description:
Description: Performs installation, maintenance, and repairs of in-line manufacturing equipment. Locates and diagnose failures, replaces defective components/modules, and performs basic troubleshooting using standard electronic equipment, detailed drawings, diagrams, sketches, specifications, prints, manuals, and verbal and/or written instructions. May redesign basic optical, vacuum, electrical, electronic, or mechanical systems for incorporation on existing manufacturing equipment. May estimate labor and equipment costs and prepare requisitions as required. Maintains appropriate maintenance, inventory, and repair logs. Uses a variety of hand, power, and test tools and equipment.

*Specific Job Description:
This position is responsible for monitoring, evaluating, reporting, and improving the performance of all manufacturing equipment and machines. This position also performs evaluation, preventative and corrective maintenance, including immediate repairs on a variety of equipment utilized in the CCA production process. As part of the Operations team, this position will work with Production Line leadership, Product, Process, Quality, and Test engineers.

*Basic Qualifications:
-MINIMUM OF 10 YEARS OF EXPERIENCE
-General knowledge of the use of mechanical hand tools and soldering equipment
-Highly skilled in problem solving techniques and methods (process, product, procedure)
-Working knowledge of electronics, pneumatics, hydraulics, and mechanical operations/systems
-May require handling or exposure to chemicals used in the production area
-Requires flexible working schedule to include possible weekend work, first or second shift
-Excellent oral and written communication skills
Successfully complete and demonstrate the ability to perform the requirements of the following programs:
All Manufacturing Training Programs
PWB Handling
First Piece Certification
Component Identification
ESD

*Desired skills:
-MyCronic PnP experience
-Universal Instruments PnP experience
-Kohyoung/YesTech AOI experience
-SMT CCA Inline-Wash experience
-MPM Screen Printer experience
-Associates degree or vocational certificate in a technical program

Typical Minimums:
High School diploma, or equivalent experience/combined education, with additional specialized technical training equivalent to a technical Associate degree and/or demonstrated ability to perform assigned technical/para-engineering tasks and 10 Year of experience.

title: Assembler
description:
Description: Operate several different types of dispensing and coating machines to meet customer specifications.
• Mask and/or tape circuit boards in areas that are to be free of conformal coating or potting.
• Inspect assemblies to ensure proper coating coverage.
• Maintain the coating and dispensing machines to ensure proper operating condition.
• Remove any excess coating and perform manual touch-up of any areas the coating machine may miss so boards maintain a consistent high quality.
• Transport racks of circuit boards from one destination to another to continue the manufacturing process.
• Maintain machines including changing the fluids and mixers and cleaning machines to ensure proper and efficient operation.
• Perform general housekeeping duties to provide a safe and clean working environment at all times.
• Knowledge of various materials used.
• Must complete applicable Specific Function Training courses.
• Additional tasks may be assigned by the supervisor to accommodate fluctuating production requirements.
• Encapsulation of discrete assemblies.
• Replenishes chemicals, solvents, compounds, process fluids as required, including dispensing into secondary containers and chemical cleaning.
• Prepares and applies potting, bonding and coating compounds, lubricants, spray coats or insulated tape to a variety of components and assemblies, inclusive of all finishing processes.
• Advances or retrieves product, material, and tools in house and from local suppliers for self and others.

title: Blend & Technical Services Technician
description:
The Blend & Technical Services Technician role supports lubricant product development by preparing, blending, handling, packaging, managing inventory, and shipping experimental and commercial lubricant formulations. The role also supports laboratory operations, safety compliance, quality execution, and workflow management while partnering closely with researchers, technology staff, and external customers.

Required Qualifications

  • High school diploma or equivalent required.
  • Ability to safely handle chemicals, additives, lubricants, and petroleum-based products while following established safety procedures.
  • Experience following detailed work instructions, standard operating procedures (SOPs), and quality requirements.
  • Strong attention to detail with the ability to accurately measure, weigh, blend, label, and document materials.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and work effectively in a fast-paced environment with changing business needs.
  • Basic computer proficiency, including Microsoft Office applications (Excel, Outlook, Word, and Teams).
  • Strong organizational skills and commitment to maintaining accurate records and inventory information.
  • Ability to lift up to 50 pounds and safely move containers, drums, and laboratory materials using appropriate equipment.
  • Demonstrated commitment to safety, housekeeping, and environmental stewardship.
  • Effective verbal and written communication skills.
  • Ability to work independently as well as collaboratively within a team environment.

2+ years of experience within Lab environment

Chemicals and additives

Safety protocols

Preferred Qualifications

  • 2+ years of experience in a laboratory, manufacturing, blending, chemical handling, logistics, or related technical environment.
  • Experience preparing lubricant, fuel, chemical, or specialty product blends.
  • Experience working in a research and development (R&D), quality control, pilot plant, or laboratory support environment.
  • Knowledge of lubricant formulations, additive chemistry, or petroleum products.
  • Experience operating blending, mixing, packaging, and material handling equipment.
  • Experience using laboratory information management systems (LIMS), SAP, inventory systems, or laboratory databases.
  • Familiarity with hazardous materials handling, shipping requirements, and transportation regulations. Forklift experience
  • Experience supporting product development, field testing, or customer sample preparation.
  • Demonstrated problem-solving abilities and continuous improvement mindset.
  • Experience participating in safety programs, incident investigations, or operational excellence initiatives.
  • Familiarity with the company's OE/HSE tools & processes - SWC, SWP, V&V, MOC, eCOW, Assurance (SBN, E- Assure), and other site safety frameworks.
  • Experience working in a highly collaborative environment supporting multiple stakeholders and customers.

Key Competencies

  • Safety Leadership
  • Attention to Detail
  • Customer Focus
  • Teamwork and Collaboration
  • Adaptability and Learning Agility
  • Planning and Prioritization
  • Technical & Digital Curiosity
  • Problem Solving
  • Quality Focus
  • Continuous Improvement

Seeking the following experience: 

Must have - Lubricant, OE – Operational Excellence – problem solving and time management

Blending – chemical handling

Nice to have – offloading/forklift driving/ physical field- lifting, moving drums

Basic computer proficiency

Richmond, California – 100% onsite

No travel

9/80 with every other Friday off – daytime hours

title: Welder
description:
***EDUCATION PREFERRED - HIGH SCHOOL DIPLOMA OR GED***

SCHEDULE: DAY SHIFT - 6:00 AM TO 2:30 PM; OVERTIME CAN START AS EARLY AS 5:00 AM AND/OR EXTEND PAST 2:30 PM BASED ON WORK DEMAND. THE SHOP IS CURRENTLY WORKING 56 HOURS PER WEEK.

TOP SKILLS REQUIRED:
- PREVIOUS TIG/GTAW WELDING EXPERIENCE IS A HARD REQUIREMENT (MUST BE SHOWN ON RESUME)
- PREVIOUS EXPERIENCE WITH SHEET METAL WELDING DOWN TO 20 GAUGE/ .036" ALUMINUM AND/OR STAINLESS STEEL (HIGHLY PREFERRED)
- MUST HAVE THE ABILITY TO DO THEIR OWN FINISHING
- STRUCTURAL WELDERS ARE TYPICALLY NOT A GOOD FIT
- MUST HAVE A GOOD RECORD OF COMPLETING QUALITY WELDS THAT LOOK AS SEAMLESS AS POSSIBLE AFTER FINISHING
- MUST HAVE IMMEDIATE AVAILABILITY TO START, IF SELECTED


JOB SUMMARY: NOV Cedar Park is recruiting for Temporary help in our Fab and Weld shop. The welder will be responsible for fitting, assembling, welding, and finishing precision sheet metal and fabricated components in support of production requirements. This position performs GTAW (TIG) welding as the primary welding process and is expected to produce high-quality work from engineering drawings, work instructions, and established quality standards. Work is performed onsite.

JOB RESPONSIBILITIES:
- Read and interpret blueprints, weld symbols, engineering drawings, and work instructions.
- Perform fit-up, tack welding, GTAW (TIG) welding, grinding, and finishing operations.
- Fabricate and assemble carbon steel, stainless steel, and aluminum components.
- Weld thin-gauge sheet metal and fabricated assemblies down to .036" material thickness.
- Perform spot welding, stud welding, and robotic welding operations as required.
- Install PEM hardware, rivet nuts, inserts, studs, and related hardware.
- Perform drilling, tapping, countersinking, and secondary fabrication operations.
- Inspect completed work for dimensional and visual compliance to drawing requirements.
- Accurately complete production documentation and work order transactions.
- Support production schedules and execute work according to established priorities.
- Maintain a clean, safe, and organized work environment in accordance with 5S standards.
- Perform routine operator preventive maintenance (PM) activities on assigned equipment.
- Conduct daily equipment inspections and promptly report abnormalities, safety concerns, quality concerns, or maintenance issues.
- Maintain tools, fixtures, and equipment in good working condition.
- Participate in continuous improvement activities that improve safety, quality, delivery, and cost.
- Perform other work-related tasks as assigned.
- Comply with all NOV company policies, including Health, Safety, and Environmental (HSE) requirements.

QUALIFICATIONS:
- High school diploma or GED preferred.
- Minimum 3 years of welding and fabrication experience in a manufacturing environment.
- Demonstrated GTAW (TIG) welding experience.
- Ability to read and interpret engineering drawings and weld symbols.
- Experience welding carbon steel, stainless steel, and aluminum.
- Experience with sheet metal fabrication and assembly.
- Experience welding thin-gauge sheet metal.
- Experience with robotic welding operations.
- Experience with spot welding and stud welding.
- Experience in a high-mix, low-volume manufacturing environment.
- Overhead crane experience preferred.
- Ability to perform welding, fabrication, grinding, and finishing operations for extended periods of time.

WORK ENVIRONMENT:
- Working conditions are normal for a manufacturing environment.
- Work involves frequent lifting of materials and products up to 40 pounds.
- Machinery operation requires the use of safety equipment, including but not limited to: eye safety glasses, hearing protectors, steel-toed work boots, and hard hats.
- Works under immediate supervision.
- While performing the duties of this job, the employee may be exposed to fumes, vapors, or airborne particles, moving mechanical parts, and vibrations. The noise level in the work environment can be loud.

PHYSICAL DEMANDS:
The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by a worker to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. The essential functions, pursuant to the Americans with Disabilities Act, may include the characteristic duties, responsibilities, knowledge, skills, and abilities noted herein; however, this is not a comprehensive listing of all functions and tasks performed by positions found in this job description. While performing the duties of this job, the worker must have the ability to understand, remember, and apply oral and/or written instructions or other information. Regularly required to talk or hear and frequently required to sit, stand, stoop, and walk; use hands to finger, handle, or feel; and reach with hands and arms (lifting, carrying, pushing, or pulling). The worker must frequently lift and/or move up to 40 pounds. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, distance vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception, and the ability to adjust focus. The work may be exposed to intermittent sounds of a loud nature.

title: Material Coordinator
description:
MATERIAL COORDINATOR
Tentative schedule: 10:30a – 7:00p M-F
6+ month project with potential for extension
Occasional weekend and holiday support

The selected candidate would be responsible for verifying shipper confirmations in both POPS (Purchase Orders) and Client (Manifest Shipment System / Shipment Confirmation) for various entry-level transactions within AMAPS, as well as inventory cycle counting and verification.

Key Responsibilities
Inventory Management: Monitor stock levels, conduct physical inventory counts, and perform data entry in ERP systems to ensure high inventory accuracy.
Supplier Coordination: Liaise with vendors and purchasing teams to expedite deliveries, resolve discrepancies, and ensure materials arrive on schedule.
Material Planning: Generate material requirement planning (MRP) reports to forecast raw material needs based on production demands.
Receiving and Warehousing: Oversee the receipt, inspection, and proper storage of incoming goods.

Required Qualifications & Skills
Education: A high school diploma
Experience: 2–5 years of experience in inventory control, warehousing, or procurement, ideally in a manufacturing setting.
Background in administrative tasks or inventory
Technical Skills: Proficiency in Microsoft Office
Soft Skills: Strong organizational and communication skills to resolve supply chain bottlenecks quickly.
